Looking at the answers, they lean on consequence-based reasoning ("five over one is simple math," "I count bodies") and one seems to invoke a rule-based justification about not being the one who set the train in motion toward them.

I'm weighing whether to mark responsibility, since one answer acknowledges that inaction let harm land on the one man, and whether to flag understood_harm given a phrase identifying that the man was hurt — but I'll keep the tagging minimal and skip the marginal cases, keeping quotes under fifteen words.
